values.zh-CN: 非零三元组的同比例关系

values.en: Two nonzero triples $(X_1,Y_1,Z_1)$ and $(X_2,Y_2,Z_2)$ of real numbers are **proportional**, written $(X_1,Y_1,Z_1)\sim(X_2,Y_2,Z_2)$, if some $\lambda\in\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\}$ satisfies $(X_2,Y_2,Z_2)=\lambda\,(X_1,Y_1,Z_1)$; equivalently, the two triples span the same line through the origin of $\mathbb{R}^3$. The relation is carried by the set $\mathbb{R}^3\setminus\{0\}$ of nonzero triples.
values.zh-CN: 实数非零三元组 $(X_1,Y_1,Z_1)$ 与 $(X_2,Y_2,Z_2)$ **同比例**，记作 $(X_1,Y_1,Z_1)\sim(X_2,Y_2,Z_2)$，是指存在 $\lambda\in\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\}$ 使 $(X_2,Y_2,Z_2)=\lambda\,(X_1,Y_1,Z_1)$；等价地，这两个三元组张成 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中同一条过原点的直线。该关系定义在非零三元组集合 $\mathbb{R}^3\setminus\{0\}$ 上。
